messages:
Maya (CSM): Morning team — Day 0 orientation for Aventis Labs is tomorrow 10am PT. Goal: align stakeholders, confirm success criteria, and lock the 30/60/90 timeline. I will own customer comms and take notes.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Got it. I'll bring the integration checklist, a curl demo, and a short troubleshooting playbook. Can someone confirm who owns API key rotation notes?
Olivia (Eng): I'll own key rotation docs and add KMS notes to the runbook. Also will prepare the sample prompt set and latency targets we discussed.
Leo (Product): Draft success criteria to discuss: 1) 95th-pctl latency < 350ms on standard prompt, 2) sustained throughput >= 10 rps on dedicated pool, 3) embedding similarity >= 0.85 on their eval set, 4) no P0 regressions in first week. Thoughts?
Maya (CSM): Looks solid, Leo — I'll present this and capture any edits from Aventis stakeholders.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick ask — do we have a scrubbed staging dataset from Aventis? Raj mentioned a limited subset yesterday. Need it for the live demo.
Maya (CSM): Yes, Raj shared a scrubbed subset under legal OK. I'll upload to the shared S3 path and post link here once it's done. ETA: EOD today.
Olivia (Eng): Heads up: I'll add two rollout feature flags and a fallback model policy so the demo can flip between canary/production. Config snippet I'll add to the PR:
```
routing_policy: regional_preferred
fallback: redwood-compact-quant
canary: true
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): Perfect. For the integration demo I'll use that fallback in the curl example so the customer sees graceful degradation.
Maya (CSM): Action items (brief):
- Maya: confirm dataset upload + share S3 link (due: today 6pm PT)
- Sam: prepare integration demo + curl snippet (due: tomorrow 9am PT)
- Olivia: add flags + wire up latency dashboards (due: tomorrow 8am PT)
- Leo: finalize success metrics doc and invite internal stakeholders (due: today 5pm PT)
Onboard Bot: Calendar invite sent to aventis.kickoff@aventis.com for 2025-04-03 10:00 PT — meeting link, dial-in, and agenda attached.
Leo (Product): Risk note: renewal risk if POC can't hit throughput during week 1. Proposal: reserve burst dedicated capacity for first 7 days and track cost delta.
Sam (Solutions Eng): +1 to burst reserve. We can enable burst and set alerts to auto-fallback to hosted model and notify the SRE channel if utilization > 80%.
Maya (CSM): I'll surface the burst recommendation in the kickoff and include an estimated cost impact for transparency. Also proposing weekly health syncs for month 1, then biweekly.
Olivia (Eng): I'll add alerting for QoE regressions tied to our eval set and wire up a small dashboard for Maya to share with Aventis.
Maya (CSM): One more: please add a one-slide data handling checklist (S3 path, KMS keys, retention) to the agenda before I send it.
Leo (Product): Adding KMS + data checklist now.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — I'll send the final agenda in 30m and post the S3 link when uploaded. :rocket:
